title: Flux-OPD: On-Policy Distillation with Evolving Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2607.28022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model training in open-ended domains lacks verifiable rewards, making task preferences difficult to formalize as effective supervision. Contexts derived from task feedback can provide richer supervision, yet fixed contexts cannot adapt as the student evolves, motivating contexts that evolve with student performance. However, directly using evolving contexts as in-training supervision results in unstable distillation targets and conflicting distributions, requiring mechanisms to stabilize the target and downweight conflicts. In this paper, we characterize context distillation through a reverse-KL decomposition, showing that the student is distilled toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, while the objective contains a conflict term measuring disagreement among these teachers. translated_title: Flux-OPD：基于演化上下文的在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 开放式领域的大语言模型训练缺乏可验证的奖励，使得任务偏好难以被形式化为有效的监督信号。源自任务反馈的上下文可以提供更丰富的监督，然而固定的上下文无法随学生模型能力的提升而自适应调整，这促使人们考虑随学生表现而演化的上下文。然而，直接将演化上下文用作训练中的监督会导致蒸馏目标不稳定和分布冲突，因此需要相应的机制来稳定目标并对冲突进行降权。在本文中，我们通过反向KL散度分解来刻画上下文蒸馏，表明学生模型被蒸馏向上下文条件化的多个教师模型的几何平均值，同时该目标函数包含一个衡量教师之间分歧的冲突项。受此理论刻画的启发，我们提出了Flux-OPD，一种将演化上下文作为训练中监督的OPD范式……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 提出Flux-OPD在线策略蒸馏范式，通过反向KL分解证明学生模型被蒸馏向上下文条件化教师的几何均值，并利用随学生演化的上下文作为训练监督来稳定蒸馏目标、降低教师间冲突，从而解决开放式领域缺乏可验证奖励的监督难题。
en_tdlr: Flux-OPD is an on-policy distillation paradigm that uses evolving contexts as in-training supervision, grounded in a reverse-KL decomposition showing the student distills toward the geometric mean of context-conditioned teachers, with mechanisms to stabilize targets and downweight teacher conflicts for open-ended domains lacking verifiable rewards.
